integrity: The coefficient laws follow from Frisch--Waugh--Lovell and orthogonal Gaussian OLS; monotonicity is proved analytically, while deterministic quadrature only reproduces displayed examples.
scientific_limitations: Low-dimensional fixed-design Gaussian linear model with OLS only.
The positive-sign probability is a necessary gate for selection at a positive threshold, not the full data-dependent selection power.
The residual-orthogonal construction is a benchmark; preservation of global FDR after changing the perturbation mechanism is not claimed.
Literature search cannot exclude an equivalent derivation under unsearched terminology.
title: Exact perturbation-angle law and finite-dimensional positive-sign tax for OLS Gaussian mirrors
